Not fully confirmed. No fire detections intersected the asset (ASSET-F47) between 5 October and 4 November 2026, but the check doesn't cover the whole period.

All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) have data from 5 October through 3 November. The final day, 3 to 4 November, isn't covered by any of them. The latest near-real-time file update hadn't yet included that day, because it was still in progress or not yet published.

So the property was free of detected fires from 5 October to 3 November, but I can't confirm the last day. Under the run's rule, every day must be covered by each sensor, so the full period doesn't count as covered. Rerun the check once the 3 November data is published to close the gap.

Satellite detections can also miss small or short-lived fires, so "no detections" means none were observed, not that no fire occurred.
